scope: Independent open conversational-ASR extension; not a BRIDGE ASR 2.0 metric replication.

source_status.metrics_reference: linked from the BRIDGE page; HTTP 404 when checked
source_status.humyn_score_methodology: linked from the BRIDGE page; HTTP 404 when checked
source_status.public_gap: No authoritative BRIDGE manifest, normalizer, scorer, per-file predictions, or model configuration was verified.

comparison_rule: No open result may be labelled BRIDGE-matched, compared numerically to the BRIDGE leaderboard, or claimed equal/different until corpus, reference, normalizer, scorer, and inference configuration are authoritatively matched and rerun.

WER.bridge_page_status: named and described as Word Error Rate
WER.open_definition: Token Levenshtein edit distance (S+D+I) divided by reference-token count, using the published open normalizer/tokenizer.

CER.bridge_page_status: named and described as Character Error Rate
CER.open_definition: Character Levenshtein edit distance divided by reference-character count after the published open normalizer; Unicode unit convention must be frozen with fixtures.

SemSim.bridge_page_status: named as Semantic Similarity/SemanticSim; the page says it asks whether meaning survived
SemSim.open_definition: An independent semantic-similarity metric may be defined after pinning an encoder and immutable revision, input normalization, language policy, similarity function, and conversation/language aggregation. It must be labelled open_protocol_v1.
blockers: independent encoder/version and aggregation design are not yet frozen

CSF1.bridge_page_status: named as Code-Switch F1/CS F1; page describes English vocabulary in Indic speech and transliteration

PIER.bridge_page_status: named as Phoneme-Informed ER and grouped with code-switch measures

WIL.bridge_page_status: named as Word Information Lost; page calls it a bounded variant alongside WER/CER
WIL.open_definition: Independent standard WIL is preparable with a pinned JiWER release and the published normalizer/tokenizer, using its process_words output. It must be labelled open_protocol_v1 rather than BRIDGE WIL.

lwWER.bridge_page_status: page says it separates local-script rendering of recognized English from real transcription error

HumynScore.bridge_page_status: displayed on leaderboard; page says higher is better

publication_requirements.common_cohort: Every aggregate comparison names a frozen manifest of conversations scored by every compared model for that language.
publication_requirements.macro: Mean of per-language conversation means on the named common cohort.
publication_requirements.micro: Pooled edit numerator/denominator on that same named common cohort; supplemental to per-language reporting.
publication_requirements.uncertainty: Conversation-cluster bootstrap, stratified by language; chunks, segments, words, and file-local speaker labels are never independent units.
